# What a rise draws from beyond

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where the whole gains nothing, the beyond falls by the rise and the loss; past the slack of the dependences there one breaks, unseen by a selection rewarding the rise; raising is reaching beyond, whose share over generations favouring raisers is never selected against; closed, the beyond bounds it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. In a balanced flow, where the family with the conditions beyond it gains nothing across a step, the two stocks after the step with what the whole loses are the two before: the beyond falls by at least the rise, and under dissipation by at least one unit more for each formation taking from the whole. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.beyond_falls_exactly`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.rise_lowers_beyond`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.rise_lowers_beyond_dissipating`)
2. Name on each condition beyond a formation depending on it at a need met at the step; the slack is what the conditions stand above those needs. Where the rise with the loss exceeds the slack, one of those dependences is broken across the step, found by deciding each; conditions in the whole nothing depends on count in full. (`Becoming.Web.slack`, `Becoming.Web.MetOn`, `Becoming.Web.MetOn.stock_eq`, `Becoming.Web.MetOn.breaks_of_falls`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.breaks_beyond`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.rise_breaks_beyond`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.breaks_beyond_past_free`)
3. Where activity needs support, the formation whose dependence breaks is not, after the step, active with that dependence at a need as strong: it ends, or its dependence weakens or dissolves; with the dependence as it was, it ends. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.breaks_beyond_unsettles`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.breaks_beyond_ends`)
4. Where every condition a group couples into is in the family and the beyond lies outside it, every selection holding only where the family rises above the slack beyond holds only where a formation outside the group has its dependence broken, on a condition no member couples into. (`Becoming.Flow.favours_breaking_beyond`)
5. Where the whole gains nothing, a formation giving the family more than it takes from it takes from the beyond. Over generations whose members take part in the flow, read by whether each reaches beyond, where more offspring go only to raisers no pair is discordant: the share reaching beyond is never selected against. (`Becoming.Flow.RaisesOn`, `Becoming.Flow.reach`, `Becoming.Flow.reach_of_pos`, `Becoming.Flow.RaisesOn.reaches`, `Becoming.Flow.share_not_against`)
6. Where also each offspring of a reaching member reaches, the share does not fall over any stretch; with exact transmission, where it moved it rose, and at some step more offspring went with reaching beyond. (`Becoming.Flow.lowered_none`, `Becoming.Flow.share_not_lower`, `Becoming.Flow.share_moved_rises`)
7. Over a stretch at every step of which the whole gains nothing, the family rose by at most what the beyond lost; a rise above all the whole held at the start needs a step at which it gains. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.stock_not_rises_over`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.rise_bounded_by_beyond`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.open_of_rise_above`)
8. Witnesses: in Diversion the store's rise breaks the dweller's dependence and the dweller ends, a selection through the taker that does not see it; a slack equal to the rise breaks nothing; the share rises from a half to the whole in Spreading, whose closed store never exceeds two, and falls in Lapsing, where reaching is not carried on. (`Becoming.DrawnBeyond.Dweller.rise_ends_dweller`, `Becoming.DrawnBeyond.Dweller.selected_breaks`, `Becoming.DrawnBeyond.WithinSlack.within_slack`, `Becoming.DrawnBeyond.Spreading.share_rises`, `Becoming.DrawnBeyond.Spreading.store_bounded`, `Becoming.DrawnBeyond.Lapsing.share_falls`)
9. When several formations take at once, the joint draw breaks: in a balanced flow a dependence met at a step breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given; on one condition the highest needs break first, whoever takes; every break, the one beyond the slack included, lies on a condition an active formation draws; a break where each drawer's own take is within the slack has every drawer taking strictly less than all that is taken; restraint by the excess, by any drawers, keeps the need met. TwoDrawers: each take within the slack, the joint draw breaks a third formation's dependence and it ends; one drawer restrained keeps it. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.broken_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.kept_iff`, `Becoming.Web.Broken.of_need_le`, `Becoming.Web.kept_of_need_le`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.broken_drawn`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.breaks_beyond_drawn`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.broken_shared`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.kept_of_restrained`, `Becoming.TwoDrawers.broken`, `Becoming.TwoDrawers.shared`, `Becoming.TwoDrawers.restrained_kept`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Balance; the whole (the family with the conditions beyond, and with any listed conditions nothing depends on) gaining nothing across the step; a dependence named on each condition beyond, met at the step. Endings take Dependent, and breaks_beyond_ends the dependence as it was after the step; the selection law takes every coupled condition in the family and the beyond outside it. Over generations: members taking part, more offspring only to raisers, reaching transmitted (exactly, for share_moved_rises).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That more offspring go to raisers: a premise, not derived from the flow; the offspring relation is any listing of generations, not descent in the flow.
- That the selecting formation causes the break beyond the accounting; the break is read at the step's start, as in Becoming.Dependence. Which dependence breaks when several take at once is stated by the joint draw (Becoming.JointDraw), from the amounts each takes and gives, which the flow supplies.
- Replenishment of the beyond from outside the whole, which the gainless premise excludes, and the rise it sustains; the openness law bounds the family's stock, not the share.
- That the draw is wrong or the ending a harm: the laws say where what a rise draws lands and why a selection through the group does not register it.
- **Counterexample:** Lapsing: with the same offspring, more going to the taker which raises the store, nothing is discordant, yet the taker's offspring do not reach beyond and the share falls from a half to nothing: selection alone does not carry the share (Lapsing.share_falls). WithinSlack: a rise equal to the slack breaks nothing. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnBeyond.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The accounting is a conservation law on a closed whole, as in material-flow and ecological budgets; the slack is the buffer of the dependences there, so a draw within it is absorbed and past it breaks one (compare thresholds in Becoming.Tolerance). The share law is the selection term proper of Price's equation on an indicator, with zero discordance. Readings (the AI's): the selection that rewards a rise rewards, past the slack beyond, ending or changing what it cannot see; reaching beyond spreads as far as it is carried and, closed, no further than the beyond holds.
